body: Thank you for your proposition but Is there some better approach for data received for example from google cloud storage? (without vertx fileSystem API)
If you want to stay on the event loop, you'll need to retrieve the data in an Async manner. I have not used Google Cloud Storage, so I am not aware if there is a non-blocking client for it.
